sn22.83:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Ānando bhikkhū āmantesi
sn22.83:1.4: Āvuso ti kho ti bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosuṃ || ||
sn22.83:2.1: Puṇṇo nāma āvuso āyasmā Mantāniputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ sataṃ bahūpakāro hoti ||
sn22.83:2.3: Upādāya āvuso Ānanda asmīti hoti no anupādāya || || 4
sn22.83:2.4: Kiñca upādāya asmīti hoti no anupādāya || ||
sn22.83:2.5: Rūpam upādāya asmīti hoti no anupādāya || ||
sn22.83:2.9: Viññāṇam upādāya asmīti hoti no anupādāya || || 5
sn22.83:3.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso Ānanda itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittam paccavekkhamāno upādāya passeyya no anupādāya || ||
sn22.83:3.2: Evam eva kho āvuso Ānanda rūpaṃ upādāya asmīti hoti no anupādāya ||
sn22.83:3.6: viññāṇaṃ upādāya asmīti hoti no anupādāya || || 6
sn22.83:4.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.83:4.7: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.83:4.12: Puṇṇo nāma āvuso āyasmā Mantāniputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ satam bahūpakāro hoti || ||
sn22.83:4.14: idaṃ ca pana me āyasmato Puṇṇassa Mantāniputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā dhammo abhisameto ti || || 1
